meta.title: Setting up a local copy of the example service takes six steps and about twenty minutes
meta.lede: This guide gets a new teammate from an empty machine to a running local copy of the example service. Background in [r1].
meta.foot: Source: an invented example. Replace every value with your own facts.

for: A new teammate with a laptop and access to the example repository. No earlier knowledge of the service is needed.

steps.title: Get the code
steps.text: Clone the example repository and open its top folder.
steps.check: The folder holds a file named README.

steps.title: Install the tools
steps.text: Install the language runtime and the package manager named in the README.

steps.title: Copy the sample settings
steps.text: Copy the sample settings file to a new file called settings.local and leave the values as they are.
steps.check: The new file exists and is not tracked by version control.

steps.title: Start the service
steps.text: Run the start command from the README and wait for the ready message.
steps.check: The log says the service is ready on port 8080.

steps.title: Open the health page
steps.text: Open the local health page in a browser.
steps.check: The page shows the word ok.

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: Run the test command once so you know the baseline is green before you change anything.

checklist.item: Service answers on the health page

folds.title: If the port is already in use
folds.text: Stop whatever holds port 8080, or set a different port in settings.local and use that port in step five.

folds.title: If the tests fail on a clean copy
folds.text: Check the tool versions against the README first, then ask in the team channel with the first failing line.
